name: Portrait + Right Title Block
description: Subject portrait fills the left side of the canvas; a right-anchored bold all-caps title sits over a dimmed right gradient. A horizontal accent rule + centered subtitle banner anchors the bottom. Logo slot top-left.
composition_guidance: Place one historically grounded subject portrait on the left and an uncluttered right-anchored title block over a strong dim gradient.
composition_rules: Fill the left side of the canvas with one historically grounded portrait, cropped so the face and shoulders stay readable at phone size.
Darken the right side with a strong black gradient and anchor the exact episode title there in large bold uppercase lettering, ranged right inside safe margins.
Close the bottom with one thin horizontal accent rule and a narrow centred subtitle band beneath it; keep the band a short kicker line, never a second copy of the title.
Leave the top-left corner clear for the channel logo slot.
Keep the portrait and the title block clearly separated — no overlap, no third focal subject, no collage.
required_elements: one historically grounded portrait on the left
large uppercase episode headline on the right
avoid_elements: a second headline, or the episode title repeated inside the bottom subtitle band
headline_guidance: Render the exact episode title in a bold all-caps right-anchored title block.
visual_style_guidance: Use a left-side historical portrait and right-side black gradient; preserve clear mobile-readable separation between figure and headline.
